Candidate fingerprint and tracking rules

Build checks are tied to a full APK SHA-256. Switching candidates hides earlier passes from current totals but preserves their history. Administrative checks persist; reopened prerequisites still block dependent passes.

Default is the latest general build, not a final contest candidate. Pin a new audited chess build when available. A candidate change does not install an APK.

Step-by-step execution

Three priorities. Evidence at every gate.

Records and backup

Results stay in this browser on this dashboard’s origin. No telemetry, account action, submission or background monitoring occurs. Export after each test session. Import merges observations; it never silently deletes history. Other dashboard and older-build records remain separate.
